typography.notes: Use tracking-tight for H1 and H2. H1 maximum text-6xl. Do not use generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use tracking-widest for uppercase subheadings (overlines).

colors.rules: Avoid pure black and pure white where possible. Use tinted greys. Do NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Only use primary color for CTAs.

surfaces: The 'Tracing Beam' for high-conversion Cards in Landing Page.
Grid Borders for Data-heavy Dashboards and Feature sections.
Glassmorphism with heavy blur for sticky headers and floating navs.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Sharp, flat shadows with 1px borders in Dashboard. Soft, diffuse ambient shadows in Landing page.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlays in dark mode hero sections.

grids.landing_page: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) with aggressive asymmetry. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid Mode B. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cards should be rectangular with sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius). Do NOT overuse Shadcn card component; go cardless where appropriate.

landing_page.hero: Cinematic hero with heavy machinery background image. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50. Massive typography, animated entrances. Must include a 'Living Texture' marquee for brand partners/stats.
landing_page.catalog: Immersive product showcase using bento grids. Highlight technical specs prominently.
landing_page.contact: Swiss layout, brutalist forms. Strong contrast.

dashboard.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar navigation with high-contrast active states. Dark themed sidebar against a slightly lighter background.
dashboard.topbar: Glassmorphic or solid background top bar. NO transparent backgrounds.
dashboard.content: Dense data tables, metric cards with 1px border. Use Recharts for analytics.

motion.landing_page: Heavy use of framer-motion. Parallax scrolling, staggered entrance animations, text-reveal on scroll.
motion.dashboard: Minimalist. Micro-interactions on hover/focus. Quick state transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.interactions: All interactive elements MUST have focus and hover states with explicit text color definitions. Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Manrope for body text.
Implement a Dark/Light mode toggle, but lean towards dark cinematic aesthetic for the landing page.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that sit above content.
For the Landing page, utilize Framer Motion for massive transitions, parallax, and staggered reveals.
For Dashboard, use high density grids, Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Swiss High-Contrast archetype. Do not use teal green/blue.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs. Eg: data-testid='submit-rental-btn'.
Use Phosphor Icons for sharp, industrial-looking icons.
Incorporate a dark cinematic hero section in the public landing page featuring the excavator image with an overlay of bg-black/50.
Do NOT center align the app container in App.css.
The project uses Javascript (.js/.jsx), NOT Typescript (.ts/.tsx). Follow this strictly when importing/exporting.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or similar path for .js projects.
